source_subset: source-defined pollen-success target species with complete Oshima/Niijima/Kozu/Miyake/Hachijo corrected-TM coverage
reading: Oshima is the only island baseline for which all seven complete-coverage source-defined target species have lower corrected trait matching when compared with the mean of the other four islands. Alternate island baselines show substantially weaker directional coherence, so the Oshima-associated pattern is not a generic artefact of choosing any island as baseline.
claim_boundary: This is a post-hoc descriptive specificity audit. Oshima is the sole bridge-state geographic site, so an Oshima-specific habitat, environment or history effect remains inseparable from the pollinator-regime contrast. The seven plant species share the same island environments and are not seven independent geographic boundary experiments.
